text: Ten monks wait across the island.

name: t_team
text: 3 v 3  ·  Fifteen minutes  ·  Every word counts.

name: real
text: Recorded in game: six game clients playing one 3 v 3 match.

name: c_guide
sub: Opens on first launch, and any time from Settings.

name: c_letters
sub: ᜊ is ba, ᜃ is ka, ᜎ is la. Tap any key to hear it read.

name: c_marks
sub: A mark above says e/i, below says o/u. The cross drops the vowel.

name: c_build
sub: bahay (house): ᜊ ba, then ᜑ ha, then ᜌ᜔ y.

name: c_turn
sub: Write aso and ibon before your first match.

name: c_find
sub: Pick an adventurer. Matchmaking fills two teams of three.

name: c_intro
sub: Ten monks, one Monastery, fifteen minutes.

name: c_walk
sub: The stick moves you. Monks your team has seen show on the minimap.

name: c_monk
sub: Tap GO to see the word he keeps.

name: c_type
sub: Ranked matches show no hints: you spell it yourself.

name: c_correct
sub: Correct. Now carry the word to the Monastery.

name: c_wrong
sub: A wrong answer means a 10-second wait before trying again.

name: c_deposit
sub: Only deposited words score.

name: c_race
sub: The first team to deposit every word wins.

name: c_results
sub: Both teams' words, and every word in Baybayin.

name: c_records
sub: Your matches, and the leaderboard.

name: c_room
sub: Share a four-character code. Friends choose a side.

name: c_watch
sub: Spectators follow both teams live, for the big screen.

name: c_practice
sub: The same game alone and offline, with the keys labelled.
